name: GraphQL
summary: Query language and type-system/schema definition language for APIs, created at Facebook in 2012 and open-sourced in 2015; clients send hierarchical selection sets that are validated against a typed schema and executed by resolvers. Maintained by the GraphQL Foundation (Linux Foundation).

level_notes.1: The GraphQL Specification (spec.graphql.org) is normative, released in dated editions (July2015, October2015, October2016, June2018, October2021, September2025) with a rolling working draft; changes go through the RFC process of the GraphQL Working Group. Deep links point at the September 2025 edition. GraphQL-over-HTTP is a separate draft spec.
level_notes.0: graphql-js is the reference implementation that tracks the spec (branch 17.x.x linked; 16.x.x is the stable line). Independent implementations: graphql-java, graphql-core (Python port of graphql-js), graphql-ruby, Juniper and async-graphql (Rust), gqlgen (Go), GraphQL.NET.
level_notes.2: graphql.org/learn is the official tutorial; formal analyses: Hartig & Pérez (semantics and complexity) and the GraphCoQL mechanisation in Coq.
